courses.title: Language, Philosophy, and Culture
courses.choice_note: Note: Select from ENGL 2322, ENGL 2323, ENGL 2327, ENGL 2328, ENGL 2332, ENGL 2333, HUMA 1301, HUMA 1302, PHIL 1301, PHIL 1304, or PHIL 2306. courses.title: Mathematics
courses.choice_note: Note: Suggested courses: MATH 1314 or MATH 1342. Or select a course from the Mathematics section of the Core Curriculum Course List. It is recommended that students transferring to Texas State take MATH 1314; students transferring to the University of Texas take MATH 1342. All other students planning to transfer to a four-year university should consult with a counselor or an advisor.

courses.choice_note: Note: Select from SPCH 1311, SPCH 1315, SPCH 1318, or SPCH 1321.

prereq.raw: Students must have completed a first semester college Spanish course of at least four semester hours with a grade of C or better, or have equivalent credit by examination.
